transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: Monitor batches always leave updates empty. They publish capabilities or a degraded coverage notice.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: USER_INPUT starts turn id turn:<step>. PLANNER_RESPONSE with string content completes it with stopReason planner-response. ERROR_MESSAGE fails the current or step turn.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: The transcript record confidence is derived because the turn join is synthesized. CHECKPOINT does not end a turn.
